custody_invariants: protected held-out case identities and expected invariants are digest-bound before paired outcome access
the V2 subject commit, V1 freeze commit, scoring logic and resource manifest are immutable for the run identity
case authoring/selection and outcome-producing subject code may not be the sole evaluator authority
where human or model judgment is required, V1/V2 outputs are presented in randomized/blinded order when feasible
an evaluator PASS is evidence under the frozen evaluator contract, not self-granting scientific authority
digest/provenance custody establishes integrity and replay identity only, not scientific correctness
same-model, same-data or same-source evaluators are not counted as independent without a declared dependence disposition
public availability of a case does not confer protected custody
any evaluator, scorer, criterion or case mutation after subject-output access creates a new run identity and invalidates the prior parity terminal
negative, blocked and CANNOT_CHECK outcomes remain admissible and may not be hidden by selection or reporting

protected_case_registry.rule: public V1-native sources may seed held-out cases but do not themselves count as protected custody
